biography:
Currently working at 174 Power Global as Director of Data Center Site Acquisition and Development. Focused on developing an entirely new product offering in the data center landscape - Powered Land. My team and I are developing engineered solutions for prepositioned sites with 100's of MW of bridge power available to allow data centers to expedited construction and operation while waiting for electric utility interconnection and power availability. We will select an ideal site for a data center, ensure entitlements are in place, professionally executed due diligence by 3rd-Party engineering firm, utility resources are available, construct necessary power generation plants for the specified capacity, up to 1GW+, and all local, state and federal incentives for construction are in place for our client. 

Prior to this I worked at Microsoft delivering mission critical data center sites for CO+I in AMERS East and MidWest. Before Microsoft, I worked in the commercial real estate sector - specifically in the market rate and affordable residential markets. Prior to that I earned my Masters in Real Estate from Harvard during which I undertook courses across Harvard Business School, Harvard Kennedy School of Government and Graduate School of Design in real estate finance, deal structuring, negotiation tactics, urban planning and project delivery.
